shots.p: wide shot of a calm desert dawn, soft golden light spreading over dunes, a single open path leading toward the rising sun, serene and reverent atmosphere
aerial view of the whole living world at sunrise: green valleys, rivers, flocks of birds and grazing herds under a vast bright sky, everything cared for and nourished
medium shot of an Arab farmer in a white long robe raising his hands in gratitude beside his ripe wheat field at golden hour
wide shot of gentle rain falling on dry cracked earth that turns green with new sprouts, soft light breaking through clouds, sense of all-embracing mercy
low angle view of a vast silent plain under a heavy dawn sky, a large balance scale standing alone in the center, solemn and awe-inspiring
close-up on the face of an elderly bearded man reciting in prayer, eyes moist with thought of the final reckoning, lamp light in a quiet mosque
wide shot of rows of believers in long robes bowing together in prostration inside a simple stone mosque at dawn, unified and humble
close-up on the open upturned hands of a young man in prayer, asking for help, soft window light
aerial view of one straight clear road running through a confusing maze of winding paths in the desert, lit by morning sun
medium shot of a traveler in a long robe walking steadily along the straight lit road toward a green oasis
wide shot of a caravan of righteous travelers walking calmly on a bright straight road toward a green valley, peaceful faces
wide shot of side paths fading into dark fog and barren rocks where scattered figures wander lost, viewed from the bright main road
